bundle.shortDescription: Local-first AI workspace for confidential client work
bundle.longDescription: Advisor Prep Hero is a local-first AI workspace for financial advisors who handle confidential client work. Your files stay on your machine. Bring your own API key or run AI models locally with Ollama. Supports RIAs, advisors, CPAs, and consultants where client confidentiality is non-negotiable.
